--- create_change_stream_if_not_exists.sql
CREATE CHANGE STREAM IF NOT EXISTS SingerUpdates FOR Singers

--- AST
&ast.CreateChangeStream{
  IfNotExists: true,
  Name:        &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 35,
    NameEnd: 48,
    Name:    "SingerUpdates",
  },
  For: &ast.ChangeStreamForTables{
    For:    49,
    Tables: []*ast.ChangeStreamForTable{
      &ast.ChangeStreamForTable{
        Rparen:    -1,
        TableName: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 53,
          NameEnd: 60,
          Name:    "Singers",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE CHANGE STREAM IF NOT EXISTS SingerUpdates FOR Singers
